title: Years with George and Julia Lee, then Thamon Hayes
summary: He was with George Lee about five years from 1925-26, then joined Thamon Hayes around 1931 for about three years, with two Chicago trips.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs

blocks.x: And you worked out of there all the time and played all these gigs. Were you -- you were with George Lee for a long time, and Julia Lee.
Oh, yes.
You probably spent more time when that band than any other band.
That's right, yeah. That's right.
What -- I'm just going to make sure that we get back to George and Julia Lee, but I just want to get this chronology down first. What years were you with George Lee?
That was back in --
Well, you were with him a lot of years.
What span did that cover?
Let's see, I think that was about in the twenties, around about '25 or '26.
Until when?
I was with George around about five years, I think.
Is that all?
Yeah.
Five years. So that would up until 1931.
That's right.
Is that when you started out with your own band or did you join some other band. No, that would be about the time you went with Thamon Hayes.
Right.
You left George Lee to go with Thamon Hayes.
Right.

That terrific, tremendous band. I just read an article on Thamon Hayes' band and the headline was "the Kansas City band that fame just eluded." And I think that was a wonderful title for that article. We're going to get back to that band. Now you went with Thamon Hayes in about '31, '32. '31. Now, how long were you with that band?
Well, I was with them about -- let me
see, I guess about three or four years. About three years. Well, you went to Chicago with them I guess when they went up there. Twice.
Twice.
All right, that takes you up to '34, '35, and then what happened when you left Thamon Hayes' great band?
